errors.text_span: Das Diagramm zeigt die Terminpreise für die Sommerlieferungen im Marktgebiet des Trading Hub Europe (THE) im Zeitverlauf von 2025 bis 2029.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the figure as a single diagram spanning from 2025 to 2029. The figure actually consists of two separate line plots: one for summer deliveries (2025-2027) and one for annual deliveries (2026-2029).

errors.text_span: Die x-Achse stellt die Jahre 2025, 2026, 2027 und 2029 dar
errors.evidence: This description of the x-axis is incorrect as it merges the axes of two separate plots and also omits the year 2028, which is present in the second plot.
The price for summer deliveries in 2025 is shown in the chart to be just under 50 Euro/MWh, not 43 Euro/MWh.

errors.text_span: Die blaue Linie stellt die Terminpreise für die Sommerlieferungen dar, beginnend bei 43 Euro/MWh im Jahr 2025 und bis zum Jahr 2029 auf 29 Euro/MWh abnehmend
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly merges the data from the two separate plots. The line for summer deliveries ends in 2027. The year 2029 and the value 29 Euro/MWh (which is for 2028) are taken from the second plot for annual deliveries.

errors.text_span: Die zweite Linie, die in Grau dargestellt ist
errors.evidence: The figure does not contain a gray line. Both plots feature a blue line.

errors.text_span: bis zum Jahr 2029 auf etwa 30 Euro/MWh abnehmen
errors.evidence: The price for annual deliveries in 2029 is approximately 27 Euro/MWh, not 30 Euro/MWh as stated.
